dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Aberrant regeneration of the right oculomotor (third cranial) nerve with a "springing" pupil and long-standing ipsilateral medial rectus atrophy, on a background of a prior chronic (most likely microvascular) third nerve palsy.

1. Adie's (tonic) pupil - made unlikely by absent response to 0.125% pilocarpine and by the long-standing medial rectus atrophy on imaging
2. Cyclic oculomotor palsy - related condition, but the pupillary spasms here are irregular rather than rhythmically cycling, and there is no clear spastic phase
3. Chronic compressive third nerve palsy without aberrant regeneration (e.g. residual from a previously treated or unrecognised cavernous sinus/superior orbital fissure lesion) - the medial rectus atrophy is consistent, but does not explain the segmental pupillary spasms
